verdict.rationale: Semgrep's docs and community evidence show broad multi-language support (Python, JS/TS, Ruby, YAML, HTML/CSS parsing per semgrep-comm-5) and dedicated Supply Chain scanning for open-source dependency ecosystems (semgrep-docs-13, semgrep-docs-29), plus a working local scan against a Python ruleset (semgrep-probe-5). However, there's no consolidated list of 'major languages/ecosystems' in the evidence, and a community report documents a concrete parser failure on valid TypeScript (`catch (error: unknown)`) that Semgrep can't parse (semgrep-comm-3), undercutting full-coverage claims. Missing for 10: an authoritative enumerated language/ecosystem coverage matrix, and resolution/acknowledgment of the documented TS parsing gap.
